name: ramp::glyph_index / ramp::tile_levels

test_list.description: RAMP holds 13 distinct characters and starts with a space.
Total baked ink coverage never decreases along RAMP for the real JetBrains Mono font.
Luminance 0 maps to index 0 which is the space glyph.
Negative, above-one, infinite and NaN luminance clamp to valid indices (NaN and negatives to space, above one to the densest glyph).
For any f32 the index is below the ramp length.
The glyph index never decreases when luminance increases.
tile_levels flags luminance >= 0.86 as inverted with a bright tile (~0.85) and dark glyph (~0.12); lower luminance is not inverted.
Tile background is 0 below 0.45, about 0.18 at 0.8, and glyph foreground rises from ~0.35 towards ~0.95 at 0.85.

output_description: Ramp index, or (tile background level, glyph foreground level, inverted flag).
